title: Choose the visual world (Bolder Options)
question: You asked for bolder options. Choose from these highly committed, unconventional directions.

options.label: The CRT Oscilloscope
options.thesis: The canvas as a signal bench, where every action leaves a glowing trace over an etched grid.
options.viewport: Deep black glass ground, blazing green phosphor tools, glowing amber readouts for states.
options.risk: Requires absolute commitment to the aesthetic; half-measures look like a cheap terminal theme.

options.label: The ASCII Terminal
options.thesis: The editor rendered entirely in a monospace grid where glyph density represents layout.
options.viewport: Stark black and white grid where all tools and UI elements are built from typography.
options.risk: Extremely polarizing and potentially hard to use for traditional graphical design tasks.
